userChecks.zh: 半截裙中間唔可以有線（會似短褲）（用戶指正）

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 深綠色軟帽，連童軍（金屬）帽章：帽章戴喺軟帽黑色膠邊左眼上方約 2 釐米。軟帽戴喺眉毛上約 2 釐米，向右邊拉低。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Beret
en.rule: Dark green beret with the (metal) Scout cap badge, worn on the black band about 2 cm above the left eye. The beret sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows, pulled down to the right. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.42、P.102 寫「童軍帽章」；綱要 P.10–11 寫「成員帽章」。模型跟手冊（用戶確認）。帽章圖案取自手冊 P.102 相片；方塊人嘅軟帽只係示意形狀。
modelNote.en: Handbook pp.42, 102 say “Scout cap badge”; Training Scheme pp.10–11 says “member’s cap badge”. The model follows the Handbook (user confirmed). Cap badge artwork from the Handbook p.102 photo; the blocky beret is only an indicative shape.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 杏色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Beige, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 長褲／半截裙
zh.rule: 男團員：草青色長褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。女團員：草青色半截裙，側袋、無褶、及膝；或者女性樂行童軍長褲制服（手冊 P.51）：草青色長褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。

en.name: Trousers / skirt
en.rule: Boys: grass-green trousers, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated. Girls: grass-green skirt, side pockets, no pleats, knee length; or the female Rover Scout trouser uniform (Handbook p.51): grass-green trousers, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated.

modelNote.zh: 模型預設半截裙（一件過，中間冇線），女團員可以喺服裝分頁改長褲。
modelNote.en: The model defaults to the skirt (one piece, no centre line); girls can switch to trousers in the Outfit tab.

en.name: Belt
en.rule: Brown, with the Scout badge buckle.

modelNote.zh: 皮帶扣只畫銀色方塊示意。
modelNote.en: The buckle is a plain silver block.

zh.name: 襪
zh.rule: 男團員：黑色短襪。女團員：肉色、尼龍、無花、襪褲（配半截裙）；長褲制服配黑色襪（手冊 P.51）。

en.name: Socks
en.rule: Boys: black short socks. Girls: flesh-coloured plain nylon tights (with the skirt); black socks with the trouser uniform (Handbook p.51).

zh.name: 皮鞋
zh.rule: 男團員：黑色、無花紋、綁帶。女團員：黑色、無花紋、非綁帶、中跟（配半截裙）；長褲制服配黑色、無花紋、綁帶皮鞋（手冊 P.51）。

en.name: Shoes
en.rule: Boys: black, plain, laced. Girls: black, plain, not laced, medium heel (with the skirt); black plain laced shoes with the trouser uniform (Handbook p.51).

modelNote.zh: 半截裙配非綁帶中跟皮鞋：用方塊砌，後面一舊中跟、前面鞋掌貼地，中間腳弓位係空；鞋面開口大，見到肉色襪褲，黑色只係鞋邊同鞋頭（用戶指正）。長褲配綁帶皮鞋。
modelNote.en: With the skirt: non-laced medium-heel shoes built from blocks — a heel block at the back, the sole on the ground at the front and a hollow under the arch; a wide opening shows the flesh-coloured tights, with black only round the edge and toe (user correction). With trousers: laced shoes.

zh.name: 領巾
zh.rule: 旅巾（連童軍巾圈）；或者改戴領帶（領帶制服，手冊 P.49；綱要 P.10–11 制服表亦列領帶）。宣誓後纔可佩戴。著毛衣時領巾放喺毛衣外面（手冊 P.122）。完成木章訓練第 2 階段或以上嘅樂行童軍可以戴「基維爾巾圈」（綱要 P.10–11）。

en.name: Neckerchief
en.rule: Group neckerchief with the Scout woggle; or a tie instead (tie uniform, Handbook p.49; the Training Scheme pp.10–11 table also lists the tie). Worn only after investiture. With the jersey the neckerchief goes outside it (Handbook p.122). Rover Scouts who have completed Wood Badge training stage 2 or above may wear the Gilwell woggle (Training Scheme pp.10–11).

modelNote.zh: 旅巾顏色由各旅自定，模型可自選；巾圈畫做啡色皮巾圈（手冊 P.110）。基維爾巾圈（木章訓練）未做。
modelNote.en: Neckerchief colours are set by each Group; pick them in the model. The woggle is drawn as the brown leather Scout woggle (Handbook p.110). The Gilwell woggle (Wood Badge) is not modelled.

zh.name: 領帶（可選，代替旅巾）
zh.rule: 樂行童軍領帶制服（手冊 P.49）：樂行童軍戴深綠色領帶（手冊 P.113「樂行海童軍及樂行空童軍除外」；綱要 P.10–11）。其餘衣物同徽章同旅巾制服一樣。著毛衣時領帶放喺毛衣同恤衫之間（手冊 P.122）。

en.name: Tie (optional, instead of the neckerchief)
en.rule: Rover Scout tie uniform (Handbook p.49): Rover Scouts wear the dark green tie (Handbook p.113, “except Rover Sea and Rover Air Scouts”; Training Scheme pp.10–11). Everything else, including badges, is as the neckerchief uniform. With the jersey the tie goes between the jersey and the shirt (Handbook p.122).

modelNote.zh: 同旅巾一樣，宣誓後先戴（用戶確認）。
modelNote.en: Like the neckerchief, worn only after investiture (user confirmed).

zh.name: 制服毛衣（可選）
zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深草青色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，同埋喺毛衣雙肩肩帶上戴樂行童軍肩章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)
en.rule: A dark grass-green uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge, and the Rover Scout Epaulettes on the jersey’s shoulder straps may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

en.name: Rover Scouts
en.note: Rover Scouts (Handbook pp.42–43; Training Scheme pp.10–11).

zh.name: 樂行海童軍
zh.note: 樂行海童軍（手冊 P.44–45；綱要 P.10–11）：徽章同擺位同樂行童軍一樣（手冊 P.171「包括樂行海童軍及樂行空童軍」）；帽、恤衫、長褲／半截裙唔同。

en.name: Rover Sea Scouts
en.note: Rover Sea Scouts (Handbook pp.44–45; Training Scheme pp.10–11): the same badges in the same places as Rover Scouts (Handbook p.171 “including Rover Sea Scouts and Rover Air Scouts”); the cap, shirt and trousers/skirt differ.

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 男團員：海童軍男領袖白頂帽；女團員：海童軍女領袖白頂帽；都連樂行海童軍帽章。戴時帽邊喺眼眉上方約 2 釐米，整頂帽邊同水平線看齊（手冊 P.101）。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Cap
en.rule: Boys: Sea Scout male leader's white-top cap; girls: Sea Scout female leader's white-top cap; both with the Rover Sea Scout cap badge. The brim sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows and the whole brim is level (Handbook p.101). Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 帽章係「深資／樂行海童軍帽章」，同深資海童軍同一個（手冊 P.102）；圖案取自手冊 P.102 相片（細圖放大），按 P.101 附圖放喺帽前黑色帽帶中央。方塊人嘅白頂帽只係示意形狀：男裝白頂較闊、黑色帽舌；女裝白頂細啲、後面向上翹、帽舌短啲。
modelNote.en: The cap badge is the “Venture/Rover Sea Scout cap badge”, the same one Venture Sea Scouts wear (Handbook p.102); artwork from the p.102 photo (a small image enlarged), placed at the front centre of the black band as in the p.101 figure. The blocky caps are only indicative: the men’s cap has a wider white top and a black peak; the women’s has a smaller top tilted up at the back and a shorter peak.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 白色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: White, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 長褲／半截裙
zh.rule: 男團員：深藍色長褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。女團員：深藍色半截裙，側袋、無褶、及膝；或者女性長褲制服（手冊 P.51）：深藍色長褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。

en.name: Trousers / skirt
en.rule: Boys: dark blue trousers, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated. Girls: dark blue skirt, side pockets, no pleats, knee length; or the female trouser uniform (Handbook p.51): dark blue trousers, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated.

zh.name: 領帶（可選，代替旅巾）
zh.rule: 樂行童軍領帶制服（手冊 P.49）：樂行海童軍戴黑色領帶（手冊 P.113）。其餘衣物同徽章同旅巾制服一樣。著毛衣時領帶放喺毛衣同恤衫之間（手冊 P.122）。

en.name: Tie (optional, instead of the neckerchief)
en.rule: Rover Scout tie uniform (Handbook p.49): Rover Sea Scouts wear the black tie (Handbook p.113). Everything else, including badges, is as the neckerchief uniform. With the jersey the tie goes between the jersey and the shirt (Handbook p.122).

modelNote.zh: 同旅巾一樣，宣誓後先戴（用戶確認）。
modelNote.en: Like the neckerchief, worn only after investiture (user confirmed).

zh.name: 制服毛衣（可選）
zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深藍色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，同埋喺毛衣雙肩肩帶上戴樂行童軍肩章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)

The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge, and the Rover Scout Epaulettes on the jersey’s shoulder straps may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.121：海童軍／空童軍青少年成員穿深藍色制服毛衣；樂行海童軍、樂行空童軍都係（用戶確認）。毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.121: Sea/Air Scout youth members wear the dark blue jersey; Rover Sea and Rover Air Scouts are included (user confirmed). The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

zh.name: 樂行空童軍
zh.note: 樂行空童軍（手冊 P.46–47；綱要 P.10–11）：徽章同擺位同樂行童軍一樣（手冊 P.171）；帽、恤衫、長褲／半截裙唔同。

en.name: Rover Air Scouts
en.note: Rover Air Scouts (Handbook pp.46–47; Training Scheme pp.10–11): the same badges in the same places as Rover Scouts (Handbook p.171); the beret, shirt and trousers/skirt differ.

zh.rule: 淺藍色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Light blue, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.rule: 樂行童軍領帶制服（手冊 P.49）：樂行空童軍戴深藍色領帶（手冊 P.113）。其餘衣物同徽章同旅巾制服一樣。著毛衣時領帶放喺毛衣同恤衫之間（手冊 P.122）。

modelNote.zh: 同旅巾一樣，宣誓後先戴（用戶確認）。

en.rule: A dark blue uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge, and the Rover Scout Epaulettes on the jersey’s shoulder straps may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.121：海童軍／空童軍青少年成員穿深藍色制服毛衣；樂行海童軍、樂行空童軍都係（用戶確認）。毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.121: Sea/Air Scout youth members wear the dark blue jersey; Rover Sea and Rover Air Scouts are included (user confirmed). The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

zh.name: 世界童軍會員章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋中央。
zh.quote: 童軍成員佩戴在制服恤衫……左胸袋中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。童軍成員宣誓後纔可佩戴。
zh.conditions: 宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: World Membership Badge
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Worn centred on the left chest pocket of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the uniform sweater. Worn only after investiture.
en.conditions: Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 4 cm，按 P.171 附圖同胸袋嘅比例。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 cm diameter, from its proportion to the pocket in the p.171 figure.

zh.name: 香港章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方 3 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 幼童軍、童軍及樂行童軍佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章。

en.name: Hong Kong Badge
en.place: Centred 3 cm above the flap of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Cub Scouts, Scouts and Rover Scouts wear it centred 3 cm above the left chest pocket flap of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 5.6 cm（跟 P.93 圖案比例）。 同飛行章／跳傘章一齊戴時，飛行章喺袋蓋上方 2 cm、香港章喺佢上面（綱要 P.12 附圖 ②③）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 5.6 cm (the p.93 artwork's proportions). With the Flying/Parachute Badge, the wings go 2 cm above the flap and the Hong Kong Badge above them (Training Scheme p.12 figure ②③).

zh.name: 旅章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，肩膊縫線下方 2 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 旅成員佩戴在制服恤衫……右袖肩膊位下方二釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；由所屬旅提供。

en.name: Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 2 cm below the shoulder seam.
en.quote: Group members wear it centred 2 cm below the shoulder on the right sleeve of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge; supplied by the Group.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.94：新成立旅嘅旅章不小過 8.5 × 2 cm、不大過 10.5 × 2.5 cm；模型用 9 × 2.2 cm。圖案係手冊示例（2222 旅），各旅實際圖案唔同。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.94: a new Group's badge is between 8.5 × 2 cm and 10.5 × 2.5 cm; the model uses 9 × 2.2 cm. The artwork is the handbook example (2222th Group); each Group's badge differs.

zh.name: 地域章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；地域章在前（靠穿著者前面），區章在後，兩章相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 區幹部……及旅成員同時佩戴所屬地域章及區章在制服恤衫右袖香港肩章／旅章下方二釐米中央位置；地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；跟所屬區嘅地域。

en.name: Region Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; Region Badge in front (toward the wearer's front), District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Group members wear both the Region and District Badges centred 2 cm below the Group Badge on the right sleeve; Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.conditions: Basic badge; the Region of the member's District.

modelNote.zh: 圖案跟「區章」揀咗嘅區自動轉做所屬地域；未揀區就用手冊 P.168 示例色塊。總會總部屬下嘅區（例如銀禧區）網頁冇列地域章，模型唔顯示。手冊 P.171 附圖喺旅章同地域／區章中間多咗「樂行童軍急救章」（考獲先有）；呢版只做必備章，所以照 P.95 文字：地域章、區章喺旅章下 2 cm。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: The artwork follows the Region of the District picked under District Badge; with no District picked it uses the Handbook p.168 example block. Districts under AHQ (e.g. Silver Jubilee) have no Region Badge on the web page, so none is shown. The Handbook p.171 figure has the Rover Scout First Aid Badge (earned) between the Group Badge and the Region/District Badges; this version shows required badges only, so it follows the p.95 text: Region and District Badges 2 cm below the Group Badge. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 區章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；喺地域章後面，相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。地域章及區章……尺寸是 3.8 釐米（闊）× 5 釐米（高）。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；揀返自己所屬嘅區。

en.name: District Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; behind the Region Badge, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart. Region and District Badges are 3.8 cm wide × 5 cm high.
en.conditions: Basic badge; pick your own District.

modelNote.zh: 可以揀全港所有區（香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」）；未揀區就用手冊示例色塊。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: Every District can be picked (SAHK “Regions and Districts” page); with none picked it uses the handbook example block. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 樂行童軍肩章
zh.place: 雙肩肩帶上（制服恤衫或制服毛衣）。
zh.quote: 符合相關資格的深資童軍／樂行童軍可佩戴相關的深資童軍肩章／樂行童軍肩章在制服恤衫或制服毛衣雙肩肩帶上。
zh.conditions: 樂行童軍進度性訓練第二階段（會員章之後，綱要 P.12–13）：完成總會／地域／區認許嘅樂行童軍啟導班或同等項目，經所屬團長批核及推薦，由樂行童軍區長／助理區總監（樂行童軍）／助理總部總監（樂行童軍）／總部總監（樂行童軍）確認及簽發後纔可佩戴；完成「樂行童軍先修章」嘅成員晉團同獲取會員章後視作已完成（綱要 P.18）。可以喺徽章分頁揀「未考獲」或「已考獲」。

en.name: Rover Scout Epaulettes
en.place: On both shoulder straps (uniform shirt or uniform jersey).
en.quote: Qualified Venture Scouts / Rover Scouts may wear the Venture Scout / Rover Scout Epaulettes on both shoulder straps of the uniform shirt or uniform jersey.
en.conditions: Second stage of Rover Scout progressive training, after the Membership Badge (Training Scheme pp.12–13): complete a Rover Scout induction course recognised by Headquarters/Region/District, or an equivalent, be approved and recommended by the Rover Scout Leader, and be confirmed and signed off by the District Rover Scout Commissioner / ADC (Rover Scouts) / AHQC (Rover Scouts) / HQC (Rover Scouts); members with the Rover Scout pre-entry badge count as complete once they join and receive the Membership Badge (Training Scheme p.18). Choose “not yet earned” or “earned” in the Badges tab.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 3.8 cm（手冊 P.145 圖案比例，同深資童軍肩章一樣），套喺肩帶上：肩帶由衣領一直去到膊頭（袖頂外邊，用戶指正）；肩章方角、有徽號同「ROVERS」字嗰頭近膊頭，圓頭近衣領（P.145、P.171 附圖）。圖案取自手冊 P.145（細圖放大）。三款制服都係深綠色肩章（P.171「包括樂行海童軍及樂行空童軍」）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 3.8 cm (proportions of the Handbook p.145 artwork, same as the Venture Scout Epaulettes), the strap runs from the collar all the way to the shoulder point (outer edge of the sleeve top, user correction); slid onto the strap with the square end bearing the emblem and “ROVERS” at the shoulder and the rounded end at the collar (pp.145, 171 figures). Artwork from Handbook p.145 (a small image enlarged). All three uniforms use the dark green epaulettes (p.171 “including Rover Sea Scouts and Rover Air Scouts”).

zh.name: 優異旅團章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，袖口縫線上方中央，為期一年。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫右袖縫線上方中央位置，為期一年。有紅、紫和粉藍等三種顏色，每年輪流使用。
zh.conditions: 「優異旅團獎勵計劃」獲獎旅團嘅領袖、教練員及團員；為期一年。

en.name: Meritorious Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred above the sleeve-hem seam, for one year.
en.quote: Worn centred above the right sleeve seam of the uniform shirt, for one year. Comes in red, purple and light blue, used in turn each year.
en.conditions: Leaders, instructors and members of a Group awarded under the Meritorious Group Scheme; for one year.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 2 cm（P.159 圖案比例）。可以輸入年份：圖案底色同文字取自 P.159，只換年份數字；顏色每 3 年輪一次（1999 紅、2000 紫、2001 藍……，P.159 2016 藍、2017 紅、2018 紫吻合）。 手冊 P.171 附圖：樂行童軍嘅優異旅團章喺右袖最下、貼近袖口縫線。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 2 cm (p.159 artwork proportions). Type a year: the background and lettering come from p.159 and only the year digits change; the colour cycles every 3 years (1999 red, 2000 purple, 2001 blue…, matching 2016 blue, 2017 red, 2018 purple on p.159). Handbook p.171 figure: for Rover Scouts the Meritorious Group Badge is lowest on the right sleeve, just above the cuff seam.

zh.name: 樂行童軍獎章／貝登堡獎章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋中央（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑨）。
zh.quote: 樂行童軍完成 7 項獎章考驗中的其中 4 項，即可獲頒「樂行童軍獎章」；完成所有 7 項考驗，便能獲頒「貝登堡獎章」。
zh.conditions: 樂行童軍進度性訓練第三、四階段；只戴最高嗰個。

en.name: Rover Scout Award / B.-P. Award
en.place: Centre of the wearer's right chest pocket (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑨).
en.quote: A Rover Scout who completes 4 of the 7 award requirements receives the Rover Scout Award; completing all 7 earns the B.-P. Award.
en.conditions: Third and fourth stages of Rover Scout progressive training; wear only the higher one.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.147、P.171 寫喺左袖下方；2026 年 5 月版綱要 P.12 附圖改咗喺右胸袋中央，樂行童軍跟綱要（用戶指示）。模型用直徑 4.5 cm。
modelNote.en: Handbook pp.147 and 171 put it low on the left sleeve; the May 2026 Training Scheme p.12 figure moves it to the centre of the right chest pocket, and Rover Scouts follow the Training Scheme (user instruction). The model uses 4.5 cm diameter.

zh.name: 樂行童軍宗教章／公教章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同紀念章並排時喺左（內側）。
zh.quote: 青少年成員佩戴所屬支部的宗教章或取得最高段數的公教章在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與和平使者章／紀念章一起佩戴，兩章並行排列，宗教章／公教章在其左方位置（內側）。不可同時佩戴宗教章與公教章。
zh.conditions: 宗教章：完成其中一項宗教課程；公教章：已領洗嘅天主教成員，只戴最高段數。兩樣只可以揀一樣。

en.name: Rover Scout Religious Badge / Catholic Badge
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap; left (inner side) when worn with the Commemorative Badge.
en.quote: Youth members wear their section's Religious Badge, or the Catholic Badge of the highest stage, centred 3 cm above the right pocket flap. With the Messengers of Peace / Commemorative Badge the two sit side by side, the Religious/Catholic Badge on the left (inner side). The Religious and Catholic Badges may not be worn together.
en.conditions: Religious Badge: complete one of the religious courses; Catholic Badge: baptised Catholics, highest stage only. Only one of the two.

modelNote.zh: 宗教章圖案取自綱要 P.40；公教章四段（黃、白、藍、紅底）取自手冊 P.138。模型用 3.2 × 4 cm 框（按圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: Religious Badge artwork from Training Scheme p.40; the four Catholic Badge stages (yellow, white, blue, red) from Handbook p.138. The model uses a 3.2 × 4 cm box (artwork proportions).

zh.name: 紀念章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同宗教章／公教章並排時喺右（外側）。
zh.quote: 紀念章佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與其他標誌或徽章一起佩戴，兩章並行排列，紀念章在其右方位置。紀念章最大尺寸以七釐米（闊）× 七釐米（高）為限。
zh.conditions: 只限已獲批准、喺指定期間內佩戴；同一時間只戴一個。

en.name: Commemorative Badge
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap; right (outer side) when worn with the Religious/Catholic Badge.
en.quote: Worn centred 3 cm above the right pocket flap. With another emblem or badge the two sit side by side, the Commemorative Badge on the right. At most 7 cm wide × 7 cm high.
en.conditions: Approved badges only, within the set period; one at a time.

modelNote.zh: 圖案係手冊示例色塊，每個紀念章唔同；模型用 5 × 5 cm（上限 7 × 7 cm）。
modelNote.en: The artwork is the handbook's example block; each badge differs. The model uses 5 × 5 cm (limit 7 × 7 cm).

zh.name: 金紫荊獎章標誌
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）；最多三個，按次序由右至左（金紫荊、總領袖、榮譽童軍）。
zh.quote: 曾考獲金紫荊獎章、總領袖獎章或榮譽童軍獎章的青少年成員晉升至另一支部，可在制服上佩戴相關獎章標誌，直至完成支部訓練為止。佩戴一個、兩個或三個支部最高獎章標誌，按次序由右至左佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 以前支部考獲嘅最高獎章；只為青少年成員而設。

en.name: Golden Bauhinia Award Emblem
en.place: On top of the wearer's right pocket flap; up to three, right to left in order (Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's, Hong Kong Scout Award).
en.quote: Youth members who earned the Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's or Hong Kong Scout Award and moved up to another section may wear the emblem until they finish that section's training. One, two or three emblems are worn right to left, centred above the right pocket flap.
en.conditions: Highest award of an earlier section; youth members only.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 2.6 × 2 cm 框（按 P.134 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses a 2.6 × 2 cm box (p.134 artwork proportions).

zh.name: 總領袖獎章標誌
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）；最多三個，按次序由右至左（金紫荊、總領袖、榮譽童軍）。
zh.quote: 曾考獲金紫荊獎章、總領袖獎章或榮譽童軍獎章的青少年成員晉升至另一支部，可在制服上佩戴相關獎章標誌，直至完成支部訓練為止。佩戴一個、兩個或三個支部最高獎章標誌，按次序由右至左佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 以前支部考獲嘅最高獎章；只為青少年成員而設。

en.name: Chief Scout's Award Emblem
en.place: On top of the wearer's right pocket flap; up to three, right to left in order (Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's, Hong Kong Scout Award).
en.quote: Youth members who earned the Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's or Hong Kong Scout Award and moved up to another section may wear the emblem until they finish that section's training. One, two or three emblems are worn right to left, centred above the right pocket flap.
en.conditions: Highest award of an earlier section; youth members only.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 2.6 × 2 cm 框（按 P.134 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses a 2.6 × 2 cm box (p.134 artwork proportions).

zh.name: 榮譽童軍獎章標誌
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）；最多三個，按次序由右至左（金紫荊、總領袖、榮譽童軍）。
zh.quote: 曾考獲金紫荊獎章、總領袖獎章或榮譽童軍獎章的青少年成員晉升至另一支部，可在制服上佩戴相關獎章標誌，直至完成支部訓練為止。佩戴一個、兩個或三個支部最高獎章標誌，按次序由右至左佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 以前支部考獲嘅最高獎章；只為青少年成員而設。

en.name: Hong Kong Scout Award Emblem
en.place: On top of the wearer's right pocket flap; up to three, right to left in order (Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's, Hong Kong Scout Award).
en.quote: Youth members who earned the Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's or Hong Kong Scout Award and moved up to another section may wear the emblem until they finish that section's training. One, two or three emblems are worn right to left, centred above the right pocket flap.
en.conditions: Highest award of an earlier section; youth members only.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 2.6 × 2 cm 框（按 P.134 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses a 2.6 × 2 cm box (p.134 artwork proportions).

zh.name: 樂行童軍先修章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）；同金紫荊／總領袖／榮譽童軍獎章標誌一齊戴時喺佢哋左方（最內側）（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑧）。
zh.quote: 樂行童軍先修章之設立旨在幫助適齡之深資童軍支部成員認識樂行童軍支部活動，鼓勵他們晉升為樂行童軍。年滿十九歲之深資童軍支部成員可考取樂行童軍先修章，完成後由其深資童軍團長簽發。
zh.conditions: 深資童軍支部考獲（深資童軍綱要 P.57）；晉團同獲取會員章後視作已完成樂行童軍肩章（綱要 P.18）。

en.name: Rover Scout Link Badge
en.place: On top of the wearer's right pocket flap; to the left (innermost) of the Golden Bauhinia / Chief Scout's / Hong Kong Scout Award Emblems when worn with them (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑧).
en.quote: The Rover Scout Link Badge helps Venture Scouts of the right age learn about Rover Scout activities and encourages them to move up. Venture Scouts aged 19 or over may earn it; it is signed off by their Venture Scout Leader.
en.conditions: Earned in the Venture Scout Section (Venture Scout Training Scheme p.57); after joining a Crew and gaining the Membership Badge it counts as the Rover Scout Epaulettes (Training Scheme p.18).

en.quote: ⑭ Badges launched by WOSM / Active Citizen series (at most four in total).
en.conditions: Active Citizen series.

zh.name: 高級空勤員章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方第一行，近前面（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑰）。
zh.quote: 完成「高級空勤員章」及／或「舵手章」的樂行童軍支部成員可佩戴相對的活動徽章於制服上。
zh.conditions: 完成高級空勤員章課程。

en.name: Advanced Air Crew Badge
en.place: First row on the upper wearer's left sleeve, towards the front (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑰).
en.quote: Rover Scouts who complete the Advanced Air Crew and/or Helmsman Badge may wear the activity badge on the uniform.
en.conditions: Complete the Advanced Air Crew course.

zh.name: 香港青年獎勵計劃獎章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方中央（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑯）。
zh.quote: 凡完成香港青年獎勵計劃金章／銀章之樂行童軍成員，可在其制服上佩戴香港青年獎勵計劃金章或銀章，如樂行童軍同時持有兩者，則只能佩戴最高級別的金章。
zh.conditions: 樂行童軍只可以戴銀章或金章；只戴最高嗰個。

en.name: Hong Kong Award for Young People
en.place: Centre of the upper wearer's left sleeve (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑯).
en.quote: Rover Scouts who complete the HKAYP Gold or Silver Award may wear it; holders of both wear only the Gold.
en.conditions: Rover Scouts wear only Silver or Gold; highest only.

zh.name: 舵手章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方第一行，近後面（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑱）。
zh.quote: 完成「高級空勤員章」及／或「舵手章」的樂行童軍支部成員可佩戴相對的活動徽章於制服上。
zh.conditions: 完成舵手章課程。

en.name: Helmsman Badge
en.place: First row on the upper wearer's left sleeve, towards the back (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑱).
en.quote: Rover Scouts who complete the Advanced Air Crew and/or Helmsman Badge may wear the activity badge on the uniform.
en.conditions: Complete the Helmsman course.

zh.name: 急救章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖第二行，近前面（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑲）。
zh.quote: 凡獲取本會急救證書或其他根據香港法例第 509 章職業安全及健康條例的勞工處認可的三十小時急救課程證書者，可在證書有效期內佩戴此專章。
zh.conditions: 持有效急救證書；證書有效期內。

en.name: First Aid Badge
en.place: Second row on the wearer's left sleeve, towards the front (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑲).
en.quote: Holders of the Association's first aid certificate, or a 30-hour first aid certificate recognised by the Labour Department under Cap. 509, may wear it while the certificate is valid.
en.conditions: Valid first aid certificate; while valid.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.149 舊款（圓形）戴喺右袖旅章下面；2026 年綱要 P.33 換咗新圖案、P.12 附圖改喺左袖，樂行童軍跟綱要。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.149 shows the old round badge under the Group Badge on the right sleeve; the 2026 Training Scheme has new artwork (p.33) and moves it to the left sleeve (p.12 figure), which Rover Scouts follow.

zh.name: 童軍拯溺布章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖第二行，近後面（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑳）。
zh.quote: 凡考獲中國香港拯溺總會拯溺資格的樂行童軍支部成員，可佩戴童軍拯溺布章於制服上。
zh.conditions: 持有效拯溺資格；證書有效期內。

en.name: Scout Life Saving Cloth Badge
en.place: Second row on the wearer's left sleeve, towards the back (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑳).
en.quote: Rover Scouts holding a Hong Kong China Life Saving Society qualification may wear the Scout Life Saving Cloth Badge.
en.conditions: Valid life saving qualification; while valid.

zh.name: 樂行童軍社區參與章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖第三行中央（綱要 P.12 附圖 ㉑）。
zh.quote: 樂行童軍「社區參與章」計劃旨在培養助人的精神……參加者必須於 6 個月內完成專題研習班及實習部分。
zh.conditions: 6 個月內完成總會認許專題研習班同實習。

en.name: Rover Scout Community Involvement Badge
en.place: Centre of the third row on the wearer's left sleeve (Training Scheme p.12 figure ㉑).
en.quote: The Rover Scout Community Involvement Badge scheme builds a spirit of service… Participants complete a recognised study course and its practical part within 6 months.
en.conditions: Complete a recognised study course and practical within 6 months.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.151 寫喺右袖地域章及區章下方；綱要 P.12 附圖改喺左袖，樂行童軍跟綱要。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.151 puts it below the Region and District Badges on the right sleeve; the Training Scheme p.12 figure moves it to the left sleeve, which Rover Scouts follow.

zh.name: 世界榮譽童軍會（ATAS）標誌
zh.place: 穿著者左袖袖口縫線上方中央（綱要 P.12 附圖 ㉒）。
zh.quote: 已註冊為會員的樂行童軍／成年成員可佩戴在制服上。榮譽童軍獎章或同等獎章的持有人佩戴在樂行童軍或成年成員制服恤衫左袖縫線上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 已註冊為世界榮譽童軍會會員（榮譽童軍獎章或同等獎章持有人）。

en.name: Association of Top Achiever Scouts (ATAS) Emblem
en.place: Centred just above the hem seam of the wearer's left sleeve (Training Scheme p.12 figure ㉒).
en.quote: Registered Rover Scout / adult members may wear it. Holders of the Hong Kong Scout Award or equivalent wear it centred above the left sleeve seam of the Rover Scout or adult uniform shirt.
en.conditions: Registered ATAS member (Hong Kong Scout Award or equivalent).

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 2.1 cm。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 2.1 cm.

zh.name: 模範童軍肩帶（雞繩）
zh.place: 掛喺右肩肩帶下面，兜過膊頭沿袖窿前面落去，末端扣喺右胸袋袋蓋左方（近中線）。
zh.quote: 當選模範童軍的青少年成員可佩戴模範童軍肩帶。肩帶掛在制服恤衫右肩肩帶之下，肩帶末端扣在右胸袋袋蓋左方位置。成年成員可繼續佩戴；假若同時獲頒香港總監嘉許或高級嘉許，只可選擇佩戴其中一條。不可佩戴在西服、制服毛衣、禮服及晚禮服上。
zh.conditions: 當選模範童軍（模範童軍選舉）；之後成為成年成員仍可佩戴。

en.name: Model Scout Lanyard
en.place: Under the wearer's right shoulder strap, over the shoulder and down the front of the armhole, its end clipped at the left (inner) side of the right pocket flap.
en.quote: Youth members elected Model Scout may wear the Model Scout lanyard. It hangs under the right shoulder strap of the uniform shirt, its end clipped at the left of the right pocket flap. Adult members may continue to wear it; if they also hold the Chief Commissioner's Commendation or High Commendation, they choose one of the two to wear. Not worn on the suit, uniform jersey, dress uniform or mess dress.
en.conditions: Elected Model Scout (Scout of the Year election); may still be worn as an adult member.

modelNote.zh: 肩帶用 3D 繩示意：深綠同金黃兩色扭紋，末端有穗（P.158 相片，俗稱「雞繩」）；選單細圖係 P.158 相片。路線同嘉許笛繩一樣但喺右肩（左右反轉）：由右肩肩帶下面（膊頭嗰頭）穿出，兜過袖頂前邊、沿袖窿前面落到胸袋下面，再兜返上右胸袋袋蓋近中線嗰邊；後面一段沿袖窿後面落到腋下同前面接埋，成個圈套住右膊。童軍模型冇畫肩帶，繩直接喺膊頭上面經過。
modelNote.en: The lanyard is a 3D cord: dark green and gold twisted, with a tassel at the end (p.158 photo); the menu thumbnail is the p.158 photo. It follows the same route as the commendation lanyard but on the right shoulder (mirrored): out from under the right shoulder strap at the shoulder end, over the front of the sleeve top, down the front of the armhole to below the pocket, then up to the inner side of the right pocket flap; a back strand runs down the back of the armhole to the armpit, so the cord loops round the right shoulder. The Scout model has no shoulder straps drawn, so the cord simply passes over the shoulder.

notAllowed.zh: 樂行童軍制服頁冇小隊章（手冊 P.42–47；綱要 P.10–11）。
notAllowed.en: There is no Patrol Badge on the Rover Scout uniform page (Handbook pp.42–47; Training Scheme pp.10–11).

uninvested.zh: 未宣誓嘅青少年成員（小童軍除外）可穿著全套制服（不需扣上衣領鈕扣）；世界童軍會員章、制服帽同旅巾需待宣誓後纔可佩戴。樂行童軍肩章要考獲會員章、完成啟導班（或同等項目）先可以戴。
uninvested.en: Uninvested youth members (except Grasshoppers) may wear the full uniform (top button undone); the World Membership Badge, uniform cap and neckerchief are worn only after investiture. The Rover Scout Epaulettes come after the Membership Badge and the induction course (or equivalent).

conflicts.zh: 地域章／區章：手冊 P.95 文字「地域章在前，區章在後」，P.171 附圖一致；附圖喺旅章下面先有急救章（考獲先有），模型冇急救章，所以照 P.95 喺旅章下 2 cm。
conflicts.en: Region/District: Handbook p.95 says Region in front, District behind, and the p.171 figure agrees; the figure has the (earned) First Aid Badge under the Group Badge, which the model omits, so it follows p.95 — 2 cm below the Group Badge.

conflicts.zh: 非基本章位置：手冊 P.171（2020 年版附圖）同 2026 年 5 月版綱要 P.12 附圖唔同——綱要將樂行童軍獎章／貝登堡獎章由左袖移到右胸袋中央、急救章同社區參與章由右袖移到左袖、寰宇童軍章由左胸袋上方移到右袖一行（最多四個）、和平使者章同世界童軍會員章結合。樂行童軍跟綱要（用戶指示：綱要最清楚）。
conflicts.en: Non-basic badge positions: Handbook p.171 and the May 2026 Training Scheme p.12 figure differ — the Training Scheme moves the Rover Scout / B.-P. Award from the left sleeve to the centre of the right pocket, the First Aid and Community Involvement Badges from the right sleeve to the left, the Scouts of the World Award from above the left pocket to a row on the right sleeve (at most four), and combines the Messengers of Peace Badge with the World Membership Badge. Rover Scouts follow the Training Scheme (user instruction: it is the clearest).

artCredit.zh: 徽章圖案取自香港童軍總會《儀容與制服手冊》P.25、P.92–93、P.102、P.145、P.159 及香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」，版權屬香港童軍總會。旅章係手冊示例圖案；區章、地域章可以揀返自己嘅。
artCredit.en: Badge artwork is from the Scout Association of Hong Kong Uniform Handbook (pp.25, 92–93, 102, 145, 159) and the SAHK “Regions and Districts” page; copyright the Scout Association of Hong Kong. The Group Badge is the handbook example; pick your own District to get the right badges.

pocketR.zh: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方：下層（緊貼袋蓋）支部最高獎章標誌最多三個，由右至左（外側先），樂行童軍先修章喺佢哋左方（最內側）；上層（袋蓋上方 3 cm）宗教章／公教章、紀念章最多兩個，宗教章／公教章喺左（內側）。
pocketR.en: Above the wearer's right pocket flap: lower row (on the flap) up to three Highest Award Emblems, right to left (outer first), with the Rover Scout Link Badge to their left (innermost); upper row (3 cm above the flap) up to two of Religious/Catholic Badge and Commemorative Badge, the Religious/Catholic Badge on the left (inner side).

pocketL.zh: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方：服務年星緊貼袋蓋，以前支部嘅年星並排喺外側（手冊 P.130）；飛行章／跳傘章喺袋蓋上方 2 cm，香港章喺佢上面（綱要 P.12 附圖 ②③④；只得香港章就喺袋蓋上方 3 cm）。
pocketL.en: Above the wearer's left pocket flap: the Service Star on the flap, earlier-section stars beside it towards the outside (Handbook p.130); the Flying/Parachute Badge 2 cm above the flap with the Hong Kong Badge above it (Training Scheme p.12 figure ②③④; the Hong Kong Badge alone sits 3 cm above the flap).

sleeveR.zh: 穿著者右袖、地域章／區章下面一行：世界童軍組織推出嘅徽章同「積極公民」獎章系列，最多合共四個（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑭）。
sleeveR.en: Wearer's right sleeve, one row below the Region/District Badges: WOSM badges and the Active Citizen series, at most four in total (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑭).

sleeveL.zh: 穿著者左袖上方：第一行高級空勤員章（前）、香港青年獎勵計劃獎章（中）、舵手章（後）；第二行急救章（前）、拯溺布章（後）；第三行社區參與章（綱要 P.12 附圖 ⑯–㉑）。冇嘅就由上面補上。
sleeveL.en: Upper wearer's left sleeve: first row Advanced Air Crew (front), HKAYP Award (centre), Helmsman (back); second row First Aid (front), Life Saving (back); third row Community Involvement (Training Scheme p.12 figure ⑯–㉑). Rows move up when one is empty.
